Your physical therapist may also introduce you to foot orthotics or recommend wearing supportive footwear. During your visit, they will likely perform a physical examination, review your medical history, and possibly order imaging tests like X-rays or MRIs. Podiatrists can also identify if there is a secondary issue contributing to your flat feet, such as tarsal coalition or posterior tibial tendon dysfunction.
